title: Kuwaiti tanker fire reported in Strait of Hormuz
excerpt: A Kuwait-flagged VLCC was identified as the latest vessel hit in the Strait of Hormuz, as UKMTO confirmed a tanker fire and Russia claimed a drone strike in the Black Sea.
x_post: Kuwaiti VLCC Kazimah identified as latest vessel hit in Strait of Hormuz; UKMTO confirms tanker fire. Russia claims drone strike on cargo vessel in Black Sea. #MaritimeSecurity #StraitOfHormuz #BlackSea #Seafarers
